title: Figma vs Framer: interface design or website publishing?
description: A decision guide for Figma versus Framer. Figma focuses on collaborative interface design and prototyping; Framer focuses on interactive website design and publishing. Compare the actual job, workflow, and operating requirements rather than assuming a single winner. Check current vendor documentation and plan terms before deciding.

features.name: Primary job
features.tool1Detail: Test design collaboration, component libraries, prototyping, developer handoff, accessibility, and workspace administration.
features.tool2Detail: Test responsive layouts, CMS needs, custom domains, accessibility, analytics, and production publishing.

features.name: Best fit
features.tool1: Choose Figma when collaborative interface design and prototyping is the immediate requirement.
features.tool1Detail: Test design collaboration, component libraries, prototyping, developer handoff, accessibility, and workspace administration.
features.tool2: Choose Framer when interactive website design and publishing is the immediate requirement.
features.tool2Detail: Test responsive layouts, CMS needs, custom domains, accessibility, analytics, and production publishing.

features.tool1: Test a representative workflow and define measurable success criteria before buying.
features.tool1Detail: For Figma, verify setup effort, permissions, integrations, data handling, and who will maintain the workflow.
features.tool2: Test the complementary workflow with the same decision framework.
features.tool2Detail: For Framer, verify setup effort, permissions, integrations, data handling, and who will maintain the workflow.

features.name: How they relate
features.tool1: Figma addresses collaborative interface design and prototyping; do not treat it as a replacement for interactive website design and publishing without a demonstrated overlap.
features.tool1Detail: If both workflows matter, define the handoff and avoid paying twice for the same capability.
features.tool2: Framer addresses interactive website design and publishing; do not treat it as a replacement for collaborative interface design and prototyping without a demonstrated overlap.

verdict: There is no verified universal winner between Figma and Framer: they focus on collaborative interface design and prototyping and interactive website design and publishing, respectively. Start with the outcome your team needs, then pilot the product that directly supports that outcome. If both jobs are required, assess whether the tools complement one another and define ownership at the handoff. Verify current features, plan limits, total cost, integrations, privacy, permissions, and support before committing.

faqs.question: What is the main difference between Figma and Framer?
faqs.answer: Figma focuses on collaborative interface design and prototyping; Framer focuses on interactive website design and publishing. Compare them by the job you need to complete rather than assuming they are interchangeable.

faqs.question: Can Figma replace Framer?
faqs.answer: Only if a pilot proves that Figma meets the requirements you currently depend on Framer to satisfy. Check required outputs, permissions, integrations, and operational controls before switching.

faqs.question: Can a team use Figma and Framer together?
faqs.answer: Potentially, if the team needs both collaborative interface design and prototyping and interactive website design and publishing. Define which product owns each step, how information moves between them, and who is responsible for access and data quality.

faqs.question: How should I compare their costs?
faqs.answer: Estimate the cost of the specific workflow you need: include seats, usage, integrations, setup, support, and ongoing administration for Figma and Framer. Verify current vendor pricing and plan limits rather than relying on old figures.

faqs.question: What should I test before choosing?
faqs.answer: For Figma, test whether it handles collaborative interface design and prototyping with acceptable setup and ongoing effort. For Framer, test whether it handles interactive website design and publishing. Compare both against written success criteria and review security, privacy, and support requirements.
